_about: Field contract: human-maintained. Models never edit it. Names columns, sources, authority, eligibility and fixed rules for every field of one protocol row.

membership.note: Which tests run under which condition, and how many samples, come only from the verification plan table (read deterministically).

fields.name: specification
fields.label: Specification
rules: Use the Specification Limit from the requirements specification (PRS).
If the requirement Type is Attribute, the limit is not numeric: write 'Pass/Fail: ' followed by the full Requirement sentence.
If the test method matrix states a different specification, keep the PRS value and report the conflict.

fields.name: n
fields.label: Sample size
rules: Copy the sample size for this test under this condition from the verification plan table.

fields.name: acceptance
fields.label: Acceptance Criteria
rules: Copy the DV Acceptance Criteria exactly.
If it says TBD, the value is MISSING: do not invent one.

fields.name: test_instruction
fields.label: Test Instruction
rules: Copy the test instruction document number exactly; never guess it from the numbering pattern of other tests.

clause_rules._about: Label vocabulary maintained by people. A field's value in prose is the text that follows one of its cues, up to the next cue of any field or the end of the sentence. Used by the verifier, and (prompt v3) shown to the model.
